about: Hand-computed goldens for option_exits.py. Longs are marked at the bid and shorts at the ask. Includes the corrected trust example: open 4.05, bid 6.10, qty 2 long -> $410.00 / 50.6% (not 424.00 / 52.3). average_price units are settled by the opening fill, never guessed from the quote.

cases.name: spec: AMD 165C long x1, open 2.05, bid 3.30 -> PROFIT_TARGET +61.0% / $125.00, 11 DTE, 27 days held
corrected trust example: SPY 450C long x2, open 4.05, bid 6.10, ask 6.25 -> $410.00 / 50.6% (not 424.00 / 52.3)
short call marked at the ask: KO 70C short x1 open 1.10, ask 2.30 -> -$120.00 / -109.1% STOP_LOSS, closes with a buy
short put that decayed: open 3.00, ask 1.20, x2 -> +$360.00 / +60.0% PROFIT_TARGET
MAX_HOLD is skipped (never estimated) when the opening date is unknown
cases.why: opened_date unknown -> days_held 'unknown'; +61% below a 100% target, 11 DTE above a 7 DTE stop

cases.name: MAX_HOLD fires at 46 days held against a 30-day cap
TIME_STOP fires when DTE equals the setting (<=)
no rules configured: nothing fires, every rule named, the P&L table still works
cases.why: UNSET and missing both count as not configured

cases.name: debit call spread judged as one position: +$110.00 / +22.0%, closes for a credit
credit put spread: +$50.00 / +27.8% of the credit, closes for a debit
long and short legs on one underlying, not grouped: held back under needs_grouping, no rule fires
cases.why: a spread's short leg 'losing' is the trade working; judging legs alone gives false signals

cases.name: the same legs declared standalone are judged one by one
cases.why: long +27.5% hits 20; short (1.50-2.05)/1.50 = -36.7% does not hit 40

cases.name: average_price 205.0000 with unknown unit and no opening fill: never guessed from the quote; P&L blank, PROFIT_TARGET not evaluated
cases.why: 205 and 2.05 are both possible open prices; against the 3.35 mark a 20-500x move looks exactly like a 100x unit error, so the quote can't pick

cases.name: average_price stated per contract but only per share fits the quote, no opening fill: held back, never guessed
cases.why: 2.05 per contract = 0.0205 (0.006x the mark); per share 2.05 (0.61x) fits

cases.name: average_price with unknown unit and no rules: P&L blank with the reason, nothing to evaluate
cases.why: 30 vs 3.35 = 8.96x and 0.30 vs 3.35 = 0.09x: both outside 0.2-5

cases.name: a negative per-contract average price on a short is read as its absolute value
average_price 205.0000 with unknown unit and the opening fill 2.05: the fill settles it per contract -> +61.0% / $125.00
short sold at $0.10 (average_price -10.0000 per contract, opening fill 0.10) that went 20x against: STOP_LOSS -$195.00 / -1950.0%, never a false profit
cases.why: (0.10-2.05)x100 = -195.00; -195/10 = -1950%. The quote-only inference used to read it as $10.00 and report +79.5% PROFIT_TARGET

cases.name: the same short with unit unknown and no opening fill: price rules not evaluated (no fabricated +79.5% PROFIT_TARGET)
cases.why: 10.00 (per share) is 5x the 2.00 mark and 0.10 (per contract) is 0.05x: the quote can't tell a 20x move from a unit error

cases.name: the same short stated per contract without a fill: held back as AVG_PRICE_UNIT_CONFLICT until the fill settles it
cases.why: per contract 0.10 is 0.05x the mark (outside 0.1-10); per share 10.00 is 5x (inside)

cases.name: the same short with unit unknown and the opening fill 0.10: the fill settles it per contract -> STOP_LOSS
5x-20x zone: short -16.0000 per contract, opening fill 0.16, ask 2.05 -> STOP_LOSS -$189.00 / -1181.3%
long bought at $0.25 (25.0000 per contract, opening fill 0.25) now bid 4.95: +$470.00 / +1880.0% PROFIT_TARGET, no STOP_LOSS
cases.why: (4.95-0.25)x100 = 470.00; 4.70/0.25 = 1880%. The quote-only inference used to read it as $25.00 and fire STOP_LOSS at -80.2%

cases.name: the same long with unit unknown and no fill: no STOP_LOSS on a winner, price rules not evaluated
cases.why: 25.00 is 5x the 5.00 mark and 0.25 is 0.05x

cases.name: long decayed 98%: 2.05 per share (stated), opening fill 2.05, bid 0.04 -> STOP_LOSS -$201.00 / -98.0%
cases.why: (0.04-2.05)x100 = -201.00; -2.01/2.05 = -98.05%. The fill confirms per share, so the 41x gap to the mark is a real move

cases.name: the same decayed long stated per share without a fill: held back (CONFLICT), reported as not evaluated
cases.why: per share 2.05 is 41x the 0.05 mark; per contract 0.0205 is 0.41x

cases.name: short decayed 97%: -2.05 per share (stated), opening fill 2.05, ask 0.06 -> PROFIT_TARGET +$199.00 / +97.1%
debit call spread whose short leg moved 20x: opening fills settle both legs -> +$505.00 / +103.1% PROFIT_TARGET
cases.why: open 5.00x100 - 0.10x100 = 490.00 debit; exit 12.00x100 - 2.05x100 = 995.00; 505/490 = 103.06%. Quote-only inference read the short leg as $10.00 and the spread as a credit

cases.name: the same spread with no opening fills: the group's P&L stays blank and its price rules are not evaluated
cases.why: both legs' units are unknown and the quote can't settle them

cases.name: the opening fill contradicts the stated unit (2.05 passed per contract, fill 2.05): held back as CONFLICT
cases.why: per share 2.05 matches the fill; per contract 0.0205 is 0.01x it

cases.name: avg_open_price_per_share 205.00 is 100x the opening fill 2.05: it looks per contract, so it is held back
TIME_STOP still fires when the open price can't be settled; P&L stays blank and PROFIT_TARGET is listed as not evaluated
cases.why: 11 DTE <= 14; the unit of 205.0000 is unknown with no fill

cases.name: an unknown opening date lists MAX_HOLD under rules_not_evaluated
cases.why: max_hold_days is set but no opening fill was found

cases.name: a long with no bid is worth $0.00 to close now: STOP_LOSS fires and ZERO_BID says why
cases.why: (0.00-0.50)x100 = -50.00 = -100%; 0.50 is 20x the 0.025 midpoint, so the unit check also speaks up

cases.name: exit_price_rule mid rounds toward the natural side on the contract's tick
cases.why: long: mid 3.375 >= cutoff 3.00 -> 0.05 tick, round down -> 3.35. short: mid 1.045 < 3.00 -> 0.01 tick, round up -> 1.05

cases.name: exit_price_rule bid prices a buy-to-close at the ask (the natural side)
cases.why: short: natural side is the ask

cases.name: a quote 30 minutes old during the regular session is flagged stale
cases.why: 11:30 ET now, quote 16:00Z = 11:00 ET

cases.name: pending quantities are surfaced; non-agentic positions get a manual ticket
cases.why: pending_sell_quantity 1 = a closing order is already working

fired.ticket_kind: manual: this account is read-only to agents (no review possible)

cases.name: expired contracts still listed and positions without quotes are skipped with reasons
cases.why: expired 2026-11-13 < as_of; no quote for q2

cases.name: fixture household (case M1 rules 50/40/7/UNSET/bid): all three fire, max_hold_days not configured
cases.why: SPY +78.3% & 4 DTE; AMD +61.0%; KO -109.1% & 4 DTE; sorted by value at exit (4280 > 330 > 230); the fixture's get_option_positions guide states average_price is per share

cases.name: the same contract held in two accounts is two positions: each judged, each with its own ticket kind
cases.why: option_id is the instrument id; positions are keyed by account + option_id

fired.ticket_kind: manual: this account is read-only to agents (no review possible)

error: fractional contracts are rejected
